Independent radius2_independent_check.py enumerated distinct outcomes for all q=2 centers at lengths 2–10, q=3 at 2–7 and q=4 at 2–6. correctness.rationale: Deleting no-op swaps leaves single active edges, unordered disjoint active pairs, and overlapping active swaps on a triple. Their changed supports are, respectively, two neighbors, four positions (uniquely paired into disjoint adjacent edges), and either all three positions of a triple or its separated endpoints. A repeated-endpoint or constant triple adds no new word, a triple with exactly one equal adjacent pair adds one, and an all-distinct triple adds two distinct rotations. Thus the count is 1+b+binom(b,2)-t+2d+e, evaluable in one scan. The triple correction is at most 1 per triple after subtracting t; maximizing also needs b=n-1. Its equality conditions are precisely all-distinct triples for n>=3 or an unequal pair for n=2, giving q(q-1)(q-2)^(n-2) centers. Uniform boundary indicators have mean p and pairwise joint mean p^2, including neighboring sites by conditioning on their shared letter. The local means of t,d,e per triple are p^2, p(q-2)/q, and 2p/q, so E[-t+2d+e]=(n-2)p^2. The resulting mean is the stated one. Swaps are reversible, so the simple graph has degree |B_2(w)|-1; summing degrees and dividing by two proves the edge total. This counts labelled words, not edit histories or swaps across different compositions.
residual_risks: Finite tests do not validate other radii or other edit distances; the infinite-domain result follows from the support proof.

evidence: With the same ball definition, record 5's s=t and h=d+e by case-splitting the three letters; hence its correction -s+h+d equals -t+2d+e. Its nonbinary maximum, equality cases and uniform mean coincide.

In the indexed formulation, write m=n-1, K=m-b, C=constant triples, A=alternating unequal-end runs of type aba with a!=b. Then t=d+A and d+e+C+A=n-2; the formula becomes binom(m-K,2)+2m-K-C-2A, exactly Eq. (1) of the indexed result.
Cicirello's sequence distance is the minimum number of adjacent swaps within each composition; the inspected definition establishes the metric alias, not the new count.
